questions.text: How can we lift weekday tap-room foot-traffic by 30 % in the next 90 days without discounting flagship beers?
How do we launch a profitable subscription ‘Brewer’s Box’ that ships four seasonal 16-oz cans monthly to California customers?
What’s the most cost-effective way to cut annual energy usage in the brewhouse by 15 %?
How can we leverage TikTok to sell 20 % more merchandise online over the holiday season?
What steps do we need to take to get our flagship IPA into 50 more independent grocery stores within a year?
How do we set up a customer-loyalty program that boosts repeat purchases by 25 % but keeps software spend under $100 / month?
Which analytics stack should we adopt to unify taproom POS, e-commerce, and distributor sales into one dashboard?
How can we reduce keg loss and tracking errors by 50 % within six months?
What’s the fastest way to launch a pop-up beer garden this summer with city permits in place?
How can we improve beer-quality consistency enough to score 38+ on BJCP scoresheets?
Which funding options would let us add a 15-bbl fermenter without risking more than 10 % equity?
How do we create an annual barrel-aged stout release that generates $50 k revenue on launch day?
What’s the quickest path to achieving 4.3+ average rating on Untappd for all core beers?
How can we add hard seltzer to our lineup with minimal capital and still meet TTB compliance?
What digital gift-card strategy will boost Q4 cash flow by $20 k without increasing refund risk?

steps.name: Local Audience Mapping
steps.description: Analyze POS ZIP codes and geofence data to find high-potential but underrepresented neighborhoods within 5 miles.
steps.rationale: Sales and Wi-Fi check-in data already exist.
steps.next_action: Export last-year POS transactions with customer ZIPs.

steps.name: Limited-Release Calendar
steps.description: Plan a 12-week series of weekday-only small-batch beers tied to local events (e.g., trivia, live music).
steps.rationale: Brew schedule must accommodate small batches.
steps.next_action: Meet head brewer to lock 6 pilot recipes.

steps.name: Hyper-Local Ads
steps.description: Run Facebook/Instagram radius ads + Untappd push within 3-mile geofence featuring each limited release.
steps.rationale: Ad platforms and creative assets are turnkey.
steps.next_action: Design template creative and set $400 weekly budget.

steps.name: Partner Cross-Promos
steps.description: Offer local gyms and coworking spaces ‘bring your badge for a first flight’ Wednesday deal.
steps.rationale: Requires partner outreach but no cash cost.
steps.next_action: List top 10 nearby businesses and draft email pitch.

steps.name: Regulatory Check
steps.description: Confirm CA direct-to-consumer beer shipment compliance and secure required ABC licenses.
steps.next_action: Call ABC district office about Type 85 permit.

steps.name: Price & Margin Model
steps.description: Model COGS, shipping, and fulfillment to hit ≥25 % contribution margin at 500 subs.
steps.next_action: Build spreadsheet with three volume tiers.

steps.name: Landing-Page MVP
steps.description: Launch wait-list page with mock box images; spend $300 on Instagram ads to gauge demand.
steps.next_action: Create Webflow page and link Stripe pre-order.

steps.name: Pilot Fulfillment
steps.description: Ship 50 beta boxes, collect NPS & unboxing feedback, iterate packaging.
steps.next_action: Order custom 4-pack inserts and print labels.

steps.name: Utility Baseline
steps.description: Download 24-month gas/electric bills and map kWh & therms per brew-day.

steps.name: Thermal Loss Scan
steps.description: Conduct IR camera walkthrough to identify poorly insulated lines and tank walls.
steps.rationale: Need rental IR camera or consultant.

steps.name: Heat-Recovery Loop
steps.description: Install plate heat-exchanger to use knockout water to pre-heat next mash.
steps.rationale: Requires plumbing changes but common practice.

steps.name: Smart Scheduling
steps.description: Cluster double-batch days to maximize boiler efficiency and reduce warm-up cycles.
steps.next_action: Revise brew calendar for next quarter.

steps.name: Audience Persona
steps.description: Analyze Shopify data to define top three merch-buyer segments (age, region, SKU).
steps.next_action: Pull last year Q4 merch orders.

steps.name: Content Calendar
steps.description: Draft 12 short-form video ideas featuring behind-the-scenes brewing, gift bundles, and staff cameos.

steps.name: Influencer Collab
steps.description: Offer free tour + merch bundle to 5 local food micro-creators (<100 k followers) for duet content.
steps.rationale: Relies on outreach and creator fit.

steps.name: Shop Links
steps.description: Enable TikTok Shop or link-in-bio with trackable UTMs for each SKU.

steps.name: Retail Target List
steps.description: Scrape Yelp/Google to build list of 150 independent groceries within 150 mi, rank by craft-beer shelf size.
steps.next_action: Use Import.io to harvest store details.

steps.name: Distributor Gap Analysis
steps.description: Compare list to current distributor coverage; decide where self-distribution is needed.

steps.name: Sales Collateral Refresh
steps.description: Design one-pager with sales velocity data and GABF medal story.

steps.name: Demo Incentives
steps.description: Offer first-month 12-case buy-in + weekend tasting support for new stores.

steps.name: Platform Selection
steps.description: Evaluate five sub-$100 loyalty SaaS tools (Belly, TapMango, Fivestars, etc.).

steps.name: Reward Structure
steps.description: Design points-per-pint system with free pint at 50 points and exclusive glassware at 150.
steps.next_action: Draft reward tiers and cost model.

steps.name: QR Touchpoints
steps.description: Place unique QR codes at bar, merch area, and receipt bottom for easy scan-in.

steps.name: Retention Tracking
steps.description: Pull pre/post launch repeat-visit % and spending from POS to verify 25 % lift.

steps.name: Data Source Audit
steps.description: Document APIs and export formats for Square, Shopify, and VIP.

steps.name: ETL Tool Choice
steps.description: Compare Stitch vs. Fivetran vs. Airbyte for cost (<$300/mo) and connectors.

steps.name: Warehouse Setup
steps.description: Spin up managed Postgres on AWS RDS with daily incremental loads.
steps.next_action: Create RDS instance with 20 GB storage.

steps.name: Dashboard Build
steps.description: Use Metabase to join sales by channel and visualize GMV trends, top SKUs, and margin splits.
steps.next_action: Install Metabase on EC2 and connect Postgres.

steps.name: Current Loss Audit
steps.description: Export distributor returns vs. keg fills to quantify baseline variance.

steps.name: QR Tagging
steps.description: Attach durable QR labels linked to unique keg IDs and Google AppSheet tracker.

steps.name: Scan Protocol
steps.description: Require drivers and cellar crew to scan at hand-off points; log in shared app.
steps.next_action: Train staff at next shift meeting.

steps.name: Weekly Reconciliation
steps.description: Auto-flag kegs >30 days unreturned; fine distributor or schedule pickup.

steps.name: Permit Checklist
steps.description: Review city zoning for Temporary Outdoor Entertainment Permit + ABC event license.

steps.name: Site Partner
steps.description: Negotiate 3-month lease with existing food-truck lot operator for weekends.

steps.name: Modular Layout
steps.description: Rent portable fencing, picnic tables, and cold box suited for 300 guests.

steps.name: Marketing Blitz
steps.description: Run countdown social posts + co-promote with food trucks; collect RSVPs via Eventbrite.

steps.name: Spec Refinement
steps.description: Document target OG, FG, IBU, SRM, and water profile for each core recipe.

steps.name: Critical Control Logging
steps.description: Record mash pH, fermentation temp curve, and DO daily in Google Sheets.

steps.name: Sensory Panel
steps.description: Train 6-person panel to score beers weekly vs. BJCP style guides.

steps.name: Iterative Adjust
steps.description: Analyze variance, tweak grist or dry-hop timing, and re-test until median score ≥38.

steps.name: CapEx Estimate
steps.description: Gather quotes for 15-bbl tank + glycol lines (~$28 k installed).

steps.name: Loan Comparison
steps.description: Model SBA 7(a), local bank term loan, and equipment lease cash flows.

steps.name: Equity Impact
steps.description: Forecast DSCR and ensure covenant compliance without selling >10 % shares.

steps.name: Apply & Close
steps.description: Submit chosen loan package with last 3 years financials; close in 45 days.

steps.name: Volume & Pricing
steps.description: Plan 20 bbl yield into 500 × 500 ml bottles at $30 + 200 draft pours at $12.

steps.name: Barrel Procurement
steps.description: Source eight Heaven Hill barrels and age stout 9 months.

steps.name: Ticketed Presale
steps.description: Sell 400 online tickets guaranteeing two bottles + glass ($70) plus VIP party upsell.

steps.name: Launch Event
steps.description: Host on-site party with live band; release remaining bottles to general public.

steps.name: Rating Baseline
steps.description: Export Untappd API data for core SKUs to pinpoint rating laggards.

steps.name: Recipe Improvement
steps.description: Address off-flavor notes with pilot tweaks (e.g., adjust dry-hop timing).

steps.name: Check-In Incentives
steps.description: Offer $1 discount for live Untappd check-in with rating prompt.
steps.next_action: Print table tents with QR instructions.

steps.name: Amplify Positives
steps.description: Share top reviews on IG stories; engage reviewers to encourage word-of-mouth.

steps.name: Regulation Review
steps.description: Confirm TTB requirements for flavored malt beverage vs. wine-base classification.

steps.name: Process Adaptation
steps.description: Ferment cane sugar wash in spare 7-bbl tank; use nutrient protocol.

steps.name: Flavor Trials
steps.description: Pilot three natural flavor extracts, run taproom flight test for preference data.

steps.name: Label Submission
steps.description: Submit COLA with nutrition panel via TTB COLAs Online.

steps.name: Liability Cap
steps.description: Set 18-month expiration and max $100 denomination to manage breakage risk.

steps.name: Bonus Tiers
steps.description: Offer $50 card for $45 and $110 card for $100 for limited 4-week window.

steps.name: Digital Delivery
steps.description: Enable email/SMS delivery via Stripe Issuing API with festive templates.

steps.name: Marketing Push
steps.description: Run targeted email to past buyers and Facebook lookalike audiences; remarket abandoned carts.
